name: Member
definition: A person affiliated with the Student Club, recorded with a name, contact details, a club role (position), a t-shirt size, a postal ZIP code and a link to their academic major.
scope: All person-level analysis: identifying individuals, their role, their apparel size and their academic affiliation.

name: Major
definition: An academic degree program / field of study offered by the university, classified by exactly one department and one college.
scope: Academic-affiliation analysis: what a member studies and which organisational units that program sits in.

name: Event
definition: A Student Club activity scheduled on a date at a venue, classified by an event type (category) and carrying a lifecycle status.
scope: Event-level analysis: what happened, when, where, what kind of event it was and whether it is closed, open or still being planned.

name: Budget Line
definition: A budget line that allocates money to one spending category of one event, tracking the budgeted amount, the amount spent so far and the remainder.
scope: Budgeting analysis: how much was allocated to a category or event and how much of it has been used.

name: Expense
definition: An individual spending transaction recording what was purchased, the date, the cost, the approval state, the member who incurred it and the budget line it is charged against.
scope: Expense-level analysis: individual purchases, their cost, their date and who spent the money.

name: Income
definition: A receipt of money by the club recording the date received, the amount, the source and optional notes, and optionally attributed to a member.
scope: Revenue analysis: dues, fundraising, sponsorship and appropriation receipts and when they arrived.

name: Attendance Record
definition: A participation record linking one member to one event, representing that the member attended that event.
scope: Participation analysis: which members attended which events.

name: ZIP Code
definition: A United States postal ZIP code reference record carrying the code type, city, county, state and state abbreviation.
scope: Geographic enrichment of members; used only when a question requires the location behind a member's ZIP code.

name: Department
definition: An academic administrative unit within a college that groups related majors.
scope: Organisational grouping between college and major; used to select members by the department of their major.

name: College
definition: The highest-level academic organisational unit of the university, containing departments.
scope: Top-level academic grouping; used when a question asks for the college a major or member belongs to.

name: Member Position
definition: The club role a member holds: Member, Inactive, President, Vice President, Secretary or Treasurer.
scope: Distinguishing ordinary members from officers from inactive members.

name: T-Shirt Size
definition: The apparel size associated with a member: Small, Medium, Large or X-Large.
scope: Selecting the member population a question scopes to by apparel size.

name: Budget Event Status
definition: The lifecycle state of the event a budget line belongs to, recorded redundantly on the budget row itself.
scope: Filtering budget lines by event lifecycle state; its values mirror the event's own status.

name: Event Location
definition: The free-text venue where an event took place, such as 'MU 215' or 'Campus Football stadium'.
scope: Choosing events by where they were held.

name: Expense Description
definition: The free-text description of what an expense purchased, such as 'Pizza', 'Posters' or 'Water, Veggie tray, supplies'.
scope: Selecting expenses by what was bought.

name: Event Type
definition: The classification of an event: Budget, Community Service, Election, Game, Guest Speaker, Meeting, Registration or Social. Questions that ask for the 'category of events' mean this classification.
scope: Classifying or filtering events by kind of activity.

name: Event Status
definition: The lifecycle state of an event: Closed, Open or Planning.
scope: Filtering events by whether they have finished, are running or are still being planned.

name: Budget Category
definition: The spending category a budget line covers: Food, Advertisement, Speaker Gifts, Parking or Club T-Shirts.
scope: Selecting budget lines by what the money was budgeted for.

name: Income Source
definition: The origin of a received amount: Dues, Fundraising, Sponsorship or School Appropration (stored with this spelling in the data).
scope: Classifying or filtering income by where the money came from.

name: Record Notes
definition: A free-text annotation attached to a club record, supplying context such as the purpose of a fundraising receipt or a remark on an event.
scope: Explanatory text lookups on income and event records.

name: Dues Payment
definition: A member's payment of club dues, recorded as an income receipt whose source is Dues.
scope: Membership-fee analysis: who paid dues and when.

name: Full Name
definition: The complete name of a person, formed from the member's first name and last name.
scope: Any question that asks to list, name or identify people by their full name.

name: Total Budgeted Amount
definition: The sum of the money allocated across budget lines within a chosen scope (a category, an event, or all events).
scope: Questions asking how much was budgeted or allocated.

name: Total Spent Amount
definition: The sum of the money actually spent against budget lines within a chosen scope.
scope: Questions asking how much money was spent against budgets.

name: Total Expense Cost
definition: The sum of recorded expense transaction costs within a chosen scope (a date, an event, or all expenses).
scope: Questions asking for total expense, total cost or cost on a date.

name: Total Income Amount
definition: The sum of received amounts recorded as income within a chosen scope.
scope: Questions asking for total income or funds received.

name: Event Expense Cost
definition: The total expense cost attributed to a single event, obtained by summing the costs of the expenses charged to that event's budget lines.
scope: Cost-per-event analysis; the numerator of an event's cost share.

name: Cost Share Percentage
definition: The share of one event's expense cost relative to the total expense cost across all events, expressed as a percentage.
scope: Comparing how much of overall spending one event accounts for.

name: Ratio Percentage
definition: A proportion expressing one counted or summed quantity as a percentage of a relevant total within a scope defined by the question.
scope: Questions that ask what percentage or proportion a subset represents of a stated population or total.
